{{Quote|The name's Kad Solus. I'll get right to it. I don't like taking these pity jobs, there's a high risk of getting killed and an even higher risk of not getting paid.|Kad Solus greeting the Rebel operatives in Vlemoth Port|<ref name="Friends Like These" />}}
'''Kad Solus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />

==Biography==
Kad was born a slave to the [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] slaver known as [[Nok (Thalassian)|Nok]]. His bondage came to an end, however, when a group of Mandalorians were contracted to eliminated Nok's slavery operation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Unbeknownst to the Mandalorians, they were walking into a trap laid by Nok. But the mercenaries were warned about the trap by a five-year-old Kad, and after successfully eliminating Nok and his operation, Kad was adopted as a son by [[Avin Solus/Legends|Avin Solus]] and brought into their Mandalorian clan. Many years later, he ascended to the rank of second-in-command to [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera Beroya]], chieftain of [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]]. Their clan resided in the [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]] settlement on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]]. Kad was a skilled tactician and he would often briefly hold back at the start of a battle until he learned the weakness in the enemy battle plan. He would then charge into battle and attack the enemy like a madman. This earned him the nickname ''mir'shupla'' by his peers, which meant "brain dead."<ref name="Friends Like These" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kad Solus met with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel operatives]] who wished to enlist the help of his clan to defend a settlement on [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]] from a [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|rogue Imperial officer]]. Kad was preparing to brush off the rebels without even hearing their proposal when a group of mercenaries sent by [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] came on the scene. They intended to claim the "dead or alive" bounty on Solus' head, and attacked the entire group. The Rebel operatives helped Kad defeat the mercenaries, after which he agreed to take them to meet his clan chieftain. He led the rebels to Arumorut in his heavily modified [[Aka'jor-class shuttle/Legends|''Aka'jor''-class shuttle]], ''[[Dikutruni]]''. Once at the Clan Awaud camp, Kad helped negotiate the terms of their joining the Rebellion [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|mission to Xorrn]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />
